metal: Ti-6Al-4V, Grade 5 chemistry; EOS Titanium Ti64 powder
process: Laser powder bed fusion, argon, EOS M 400-4
heat_treatment: 800 C for 2 hours in argon, following the published EOS coupon condition; supplier must define ramp, cool-down and on-plate sequence
HIP: Not assumed; any HIP route requires separate coupons and revised properties

screening_elasticity.source: Dense TIMET reference retained for comparisons; not a qualified LPBF elastic or thermal card

study_strength_screen.authority: Explicit study criterion, not a Porsche specification or statistically qualified AM allowable
study_strength_screen.ideal_plasticity: 955 MPa elastic-perfectly-plastic approximation; no calibrated hardening, failure strain or damage model

manufacturing_definition.orientation: Computed from the actual STL; machine Z approximately 35.54 degrees above the carrier span, 45 degrees in XY
manufacturing_definition.support_strategy: Removable downskin supports; equivalent springs in the numerical sensitivity. Detailed supports and removal access require the printer's process engineering.
manufacturing_definition.machining: Finish-machine all four central bolt seats and bores, both end-eye bores/seats and the central mating face to measured OEM geometry. Preserve finished joint stack; machining stock is not included in finished mass.
manufacturing_definition.inspection: Powder and build traceability, witness coupons in relevant orientations, density/defect inspection including suitable CT, penetrant inspection after finishing, dimensional/CMM inspection and surface roughness on fatigue-critical regions
manufacturing_definition.fatigue: Qualify the actual build direction, heat treatment, surface finish, internal defects, environment and service spectrum with coupons and a representative carrier rig
manufacturing_definition.galvanic_isolation: Engineer a compatible barrier at dissimilar-metal interfaces and corrosion protection without altering the measured clamp stack or reducing required friction/preload; insulation durability remains unverified
manufacturing_definition.bolt_preload: Unknown bolt grade, grip, torque/friction and contact state; do not transfer the historical M12 85 Nm value to M10 joints

sources.role: Specific machine/process, layer and heat-treated coupon properties
Powder article and Ti6Al4V chemistry corresponding to ASTM F2924; not certification of this part
400 x 400 x 400 mm nominal build envelope including platform
Dense elastic reference, not AM allowable
CalculiX element birth/removal, orthotropic expansion and plasticity syntax
